title: Count with a Fold
prompt: Implement `countTrue(args...)` returning how many of its boolean-convertible arguments are true, and `hasNone(args...)` returning whether all are false. Both must survive an empty pack.
boilerplate:
#include <cstddef>

template <class... A>
constexpr int countTrue(A... a);   // count of true-ish elements

template <class... A>
constexpr bool hasNone(A... a);    // true iff every element is false (incl. empty)

tests.name: countTrue counts correctly
hasNone including empty pack
tests.hint: (0 + ... + (a ? 1 : 0)) == 0 — reuse the count; the empty pack folds to 0 == 0, true.
